summary: A restarted seat is sent its handoff document and the live state of its work as its first message

replay.detail: No existing claim kind or field changes. The daemon appends ordinary message.sent and runtime.reconcile-decision claims; an older daemon replaying them reads them as it reads any message or decision.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change. Handoffs are ordinary documents named doc/agents/IDENTITY/handoff.

rules.detail: A seat bound to an agent identity can bind a document under doc/agents/ only at its own doc/agents/IDENTITY/handoff; any other doc/agents/ name is refused (document-not-yours), including that seat's own other names. The restriction applies to ancestry-bound seats only: writes outside doc/agents/, by people and by unbound callers are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: New command st agents handoff write|show, a new reserved message tag prefix st3-session-start:, and a new first message to a seat whose new incarnation becomes ready and that has a handoff or unfinished steps. Only an incarnation that replaced another and started within the last ten minutes is told, so running seats are not messaged on upgrade; the daemon looks at each incarnation once and writes only when it sends.

downtime.detail: No migration and no restart of any seat.

recovery.detail: Rolling back stops the message; handoff documents remain readable as documents.
